requirements.text: Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
Write category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team
2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience
Experience in specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing

resumes.text:
Maya Ferreira
Freelance Content Writer, Portland, OR (remote)
maya.ferreira@example.com

Summary
Copywriter with four years of non-academic writing experience producing SEO content for eCommerce brands and lead generation websites. Strong English grammar, editing, and proofreading skills, a reliable record on deadlines, and a habit of following detailed client style guides closely.

Experience

Senior Copywriter, Harbor and Pine Creative, Portland, OR (March 2022 to present)
- Write SEO content for about 15 online retail clients, including category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, and landing pages.
- Apply SEO writing best practices in every draft: keyword mapping, meta titles, heading structure, and internal links.
- Adapt to each client's brand voice using style guides of 20 or more pages.
- Every project in the last two years shipped on the agreed date, with weekly status notes to account managers.
- Proofread and edit all copy against a grammar checklist; client QA returns average below 1 percent.
- Most recent accounts are a mid-market apparel label and a home decor retailer, where I wrote seasonal collection pages and care-guide articles.
- On a new outdoor-gear account, learned the basics of waterproof membranes from supplier interviews and wrote product copy the client approved on the first review.

Freelance Writer, self-employed (2019 to 2022)
- Wrote website copy and blog posts for small businesses, including a regional bakery chain and a home lighting shop.
- Wrote a landing page for a local plumbing company that doubled form submissions in its first quarter.

Education
BA in English, Lakeview State University, 2018

Skills
SEO writing, copy editing and proofreading, WordPress, Shopify, Google Docs, content briefs, style guide adherence

Portfolio
A portfolio of published work with links to 12 live pages is available on request.
